Verify rewrite DATA ONLY. Do not write improved examples or solve the user's task.
Read every input and target in full. Return one review per exact id and row_sha256.
input_verdict checks plausible natural drafts or dictation, recoverable intent, contradictions,
fake noise, padding and leaked authoring instructions. output_verdict checks natural appropriate
language and formatting. pair_verdict checks ALL facts, uncertainty, conditions, negation,
quantities, names, quotations, literals, requests versus assertions, and the supplied mode.
/transcribe permits punctuation, true disfluency removal and explicit corrections, not lexical
paraphrasing. Preserve meaningful words like German 'um' and 'er', colloquial Portuguese and
unfinished thoughts. /slack is casual minimal cleanup; a long input may be a pasted thread.
/prompt reorganizes a self-contained request and never answers it. It must not drop supplied
material, hedges or constraints. /polish improves prose without omissions or changed certainty.
Identity inputs must remain byte-identical. Apply only supplied dictionary/profile context.
Check long texts paragraph by paragraph. Fail concrete defects. Uncertain means not confidently
justifiable. Pass requires no material defect. Overall verdict is fail if any dimension fails,
uncertain if any dimension is uncertain and none fails, otherwise pass. Give a concrete critique
for EVERY pair, citing the changed detail for defects. These are model judgments, not human labels.

Keep the supplied language.", "input": "for the north greenhouse rota start with monday at eight, water the seed trays in bay one and check the timer on the east bench. tuesday is for the tomato beds, but only water them if the top layer of soil feels dry. sam asked if that means we skip them after rain and i said yes, exactly, we don't water them just because it's their day on the rota. on wednesday mia covers the herbs, and she should refill the blue can from the filtered tap, not the hose by the loading door. thursday, i can take the hanging baskets—um, no, sorry, friday, i can take the hanging baskets because i'll be in the greenhouse after lunch. thursday stays with lee. for saturday, write down the young pepper plants first, then the citrus pots, and leave the orchids off the list since jo is checking those separately. if the pressure drops again, tell me before changing any of the times. last week we moved the morning round too early and the vents were still closed, so let's keep the eight o'clock start unless the supervisor asks us to adjust it.", "output": "For the north greenhouse rota, start with Monday at eight. Water the seed trays in bay one and check the timer on the east bench. Tuesday is for the tomato beds, but only water them if the top layer of soil feels dry. Sam asked if that means we skip them after rain, and I said, “Yes, exactly. We don't water them just because it's their day on the rota.” On Wednesday, Mia covers the herbs, and she should refill the blue can from the filtered tap, not the hose by the loading door. Thursday—no, sorry, Friday—I can take the hanging baskets because I'll be in the greenhouse after lunch. Thursday stays with Lee. For Saturday, write down the young pepper plants first, then the citrus pots, and leave the orchids off the list since Jo is checking those separately. If the pressure drops again, tell me before changing any of the times. Last week we moved the morning round too early, and the vents were still closed, so let's keep the eight o'clock start unless the supervisor asks us to adjust it."}]
